Package com.hiface.sdk.capture

Interface FaceCaptureListener

public interface FaceCaptureListener
Asynchronous main-thread callbacks for guided camera capture. Progress continues until eligibility is met; success returns FaceCaptureResult. At most one onResult or onError is delivered in total. Cancellation or closure suppresses pending callbacks.
